Newton_step.method: Full-column pivoted QR of whitened cone Jacobian; no singular-value/rank truncation

scope: One read-only last-step replay using existing Float64 whitening Hessian, exact dyadic cumulative-coordinate differences and exact primal/slack reconstruction. No iterate update, optimization, MP calculation or precision-floor conclusion.
audit_source_utf8:
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
import json,hashlib,time
import numpy as np
from scipy import linalg
from smatrix_bootstrap.primal_barrier import PrimalLogBarrier
from smatrix_bootstrap.julia_bridge import decode_float64_bits
start=time.monotonic();path=Path('results/primal_barrier_N10_two_cuts.json');report=json.loads(path.read_text());r=report['result']
seed=json.loads(Path(report['seed_path']).read_text());payload=json.loads(Path(report['input_path']).read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(report['seed_path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==report['seed_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(report['input_path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==report['input_sha256']
assert all(Path(k).read_text()==v for k,v in report['source_snapshot_utf8'].items())
model=PrimalLogBarrier.from_payload(payload,equality_rank=seed['equality_rank'],equality_rows=seed['equality_rows'],pivot_columns=seed['pivot_columns'],pivot_inverse=seed['pivot_inverse'])
history=[v for v in r['history'] if v.get('accepted')];last=history[-1];previous=history[-2]
u0=decode_float64_bits(previous['u_float64_bits']);u1=decode_float64_bits(last['u_float64_bits']);origin=list(map(F,report['initial_x_rational']))
x0=model.eq.point(origin,u0);x1=model.eq.point(origin,u1)
assert x1==list(map(F,r['x_rational']))
s0,d0=model.exact_slack(x0);s1,d1=model.exact_slack(x1)
assert [F(v,d1) for v in s1]==list(map(F,r['s_rational']))
c0=model.certify_strict_slack(s0,d0);c1=model.certify_strict_slack(s1,d1);assert c0['strict'] and c1['strict']
F0,gs,W,_=model.evaluate(s0,d0,c0);F1,_,_,_=model.evaluate(s1,d1,c1,derivatives=False)
mu=last['mu'];alpha=last['step_length'];g=model.c_projected-mu*(model.B.T@gs)
p,step=model._newton_step(W,g,mu);du=model.eq.step_transform@p
assert np.array_equal(u0+alpha*du,u1)
actual_du_exact=[F.from_float(float(b))-F.from_float(float(a)) for a,b in zip(u0,u1)]
intended_du_exact=[F.from_float(float(alpha))*F.from_float(float(v)) for v in du]
error_du_exact=[a-b for a,b in zip(actual_du_exact,intended_du_exact)]
actual_du=np.array(list(map(float,actual_du_exact)));error_du=np.array(list(map(float,error_du_exact)))
# R maps exact-nullspace free increments to production QR step coordinates.
actual_p=linalg.solve_triangular(model.eq.step_transform,actual_du,lower=False)
error_p=linalg.solve_triangular(model.eq.step_transform,error_du,lower=False)
intended_p=alpha*p
intended_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(W@intended_p)**2)
actual_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(W@actual_p)**2)
error_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(W@error_p)**2)
actual_descent=-float(g@actual_p);intended_descent=-float(g@intended_p)
objective0=sum(F.from_float(float(v))*xx for v,xx in zip(model.c,x0));objective1=sum(F.from_float(float(v))*xx for v,xx in zip(model.c,x1))
objective_change=objective1-objective0
phi_change=float(objective_change)+mu*(F1-F0)
armijo_change=.01*float(g@intended_p)
ulp_error=[abs(float(a)) for a in error_du_exact]
record=dict(schema='smatrix-cumulative-coordinate-step-audit-v1',input_result=str(path),input_result_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
  iteration=last['iteration'],mu=mu,alpha=alpha,pre_and_post_exactly_strict=True,
  exact_terminal_x_and_slacks_reproduced=True,Float64_candidate_update_reproduced_bitwise=True,
  replayed_pre_step_decrement_squared=-float(g@p)/mu,archived_pre_step_decrement_squared=last['newton_decrement_squared'],
  intended_step_H_norm_squared=intended_norm,actual_step_H_norm_squared=actual_norm,
  actual_minus_intended_H_norm_squared=error_norm,error_to_intended_H_norm_ratio=(error_norm/intended_norm)**.5,
  intended_scaled_objective_directional_descent=intended_descent,actual_scaled_objective_directional_descent=actual_descent,
  intended_normalized_barrier_directional_descent=intended_descent/mu,actual_normalized_barrier_directional_descent=actual_descent/mu,
  exact_linear_objective_change=str(objective_change),linear_objective_change_float=float(objective_change),
  barrier_F_pre=F0,barrier_F_post=F1,barrier_F_change=F1-F0,full_barrier_objective_change=phi_change,
  Armijo_required_change=armijo_change,Armijo_passes=phi_change<=armijo_change,
  max_absolute_accumulation_rounding_error=max(ulp_error),unchanged_free_coordinates=int(np.count_nonzero(u0==u1)),
  nonzero_intended_free_increments=int(np.count_nonzero(du)),
  original_free_coordinate_increment_rational=list(map(str,actual_du_exact)),
  intended_free_coordinate_increment_rational=list(map(str,intended_du_exact)),
  exact_accumulation_error_rational=list(map(str,error_du_exact)),
  Newton_step=step,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
  scope='One read-only last-step replay using existing Float64 whitening Hessian, exact dyadic cumulative-coordinate differences and exact primal/slack reconstruction. No iterate update, optimization, MP calculation or precision-floor conclusion.')
record['audit_source_utf8']=Path(__file__).read_text();record['audit_source_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(record['audit_source_utf8'].encode()).hexdigest()
out=Path('results/primal_barrier_N10_two_cuts.accumulation_audit.json');assert not out.exists();out.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if 'rational' not in k and 'source_utf8' not in k},indent=2))
